adjudication.rationale: Looking at the Lark calendar service changes in the diff, the code consistently uses `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` to extract only the first destination calendar. Unlike the Google Calendar service which uses `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)` to match the destination calendar to the specific credential, Lark always uses the first element. This means in collective team events where multiple hosts have different destination calendars, all Lark calendar events would be created on the first host's calendar rather than each host's respective calendar. This is a real bug where the Lark implementation doesn't properly handle the new array-based destinationCalendar structure for multi-host scenarios.
